messages.subject: Re: printing filename and path
parts:
Hello,

Do you have two options related to the GUI:
1- File/Copy full path to clipboard

2- Pop-up menu of the editor: Copy full path to clipboard

Notice that in both cases you need to choice the mode: Unix ('/') or
Window ('\') mode.

And one related to customization:
- editing the database Options/Shortcuts and creating a shortcut.
